TITLE: Field Guide to Minor Hauntings
TEXT:
FIELD GUIDE (POCKET EDITION)

Species: Minor Haunting
Habitat: hallways, laundromats, inboxes, the space beneath "maybe"

Identification Marks:
- a door that clicks twice
- a song stuck in the throat of the radio
- socks that vanish but leave behind their precise sadness

Diet:
- neglected intentions
- half-finished sentences
- receipts kept "just in case"

Handling:
- do not shout; it becomes theatrical
- do not invite it to stay; it will attempt politeness indefinitely
- do offer a glass of water; it appreciates ritual

Note: most hauntings are only memories asking for proper storage.
